name: CrowdStrike Falcon
description: Connect your own CrowdStrike Falcon tenant (OAuth2 API Client) to manage Hosts, Detections, Alerts, Incidents, custom IOCs, Prevention Policies, and Real Time Response sessions across your endpoint fleet.

tools.name: connect_crowdstrike
tools.description: Connect your own CrowdStrike Falcon tenant by saving its cloud region and an OAuth2 API Client (Client ID + Secret), after checking they actually work.

client_id.description: OAuth2 API Client ID from Falcon Console > Support and resources > API Clients and Keys.
client_id.title: Client Id

tools.name: disconnect_crowdstrike
tools.description: Disconnect a CrowdStrike Falcon tenant: deletes the saved OAuth2 Client ID/Secret. Nothing in CrowdStrike itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved Falcon tenant connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected CrowdStrike Falcon tenants (region + masked Client ID).

tools.name: list_hosts
tools.description: List endpoints (hosts/sensors) in the connected Falcon tenant, optionally filtered by an FQL expression.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_host
tools.description: Read one endpoint (host/sensor) in full by its Falcon device id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: contain_hosts
tools.description: Network-contain one or more hosts -- isolates them from the network except for traffic to the Falcon cloud. The core incident-response 'stop the bleeding' action.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

host_ids.description: One or more Falcon host ids to act on.
host_ids.title: Host Ids

tools.name: lift_containment
tools.description: Lift network containment on one or more hosts, restoring normal network access.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

host_ids.description: One or more Falcon host ids to act on.
host_ids.title: Host Ids

tools.name: hide_hosts
tools.description: Hide one or more hosts from the Falcon console (does not uninstall the sensor).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

host_ids.description: One or more Falcon host ids to act on.
host_ids.title: Host Ids

tools.name: unhide_hosts
tools.description: Unhide one or more previously hidden hosts.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

host_ids.description: One or more Falcon host ids to act on.
host_ids.title: Host Ids

tools.name: list_detections
tools.description: List sensor-visibility Detections in the connected Falcon tenant, optionally filtered by an FQL expression (e.g. "status:'new'").

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_detection
tools.description: Read one Detection in full by its detection id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_detection_status
tools.description: Update a Detection's triage status (new/in_progress/true_positive/false_positive/ignored), optionally with a comment and/or assignee.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

assign_to_uuid.description: Optional Falcon user UUID to assign the detection to.
assign_to_uuid.title: Assign To Uuid

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List correlated Incidents (CrowdScore groupings of related detections) in the connected Falcon tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Read one Incident in full by its incident id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_incident
tools.description: Update an Incident's status and/or add a tag/comment.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_iocs
tools.description: List custom IOCs (Indicators of Compromise) configured on the connected Falcon tenant.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

types.description: Optional comma-separated IOC types filter, e.g. 'sha256,domain'.
types.title: Types

tools.name: create_ioc
tools.description: Create a new custom IOC (hash/domain/IP) with a detect/prevent/allow action applied fleet-wide (or to selected platforms).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

value.description: The indicator value itself (hash, domain, or IP).
value.title: Value

action.description: Action Falcon takes when this IOC is observed: 'detect', 'prevent', or 'allow'.
action.title: Action

description.description: Optional description of why this IOC was added.
description.title: Description

platforms.description: Platforms this IOC applies to, e.g. ['windows', 'mac', 'linux']. Empty = all.
platforms.title: Platforms

tools.name: delete_ioc
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom IOC. Cannot be undone.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_prevention_policies
tools.description: List Prevention Policies configured on the connected Falcon tenant, optionally filtered by an FQL expression.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_prevention_policy
tools.description: Read one Prevention Policy in full by its id.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: set_prevention_policy_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable a Prevention Policy without deleting it.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

enabled.description: True to enable the Prevention Policy, False to disable it.
enabled.title: Enabled

tools.name: start_rtr_session
tools.description: Start a Real Time Response (RTR) session on a host, for live read-only investigation (ls, ps, netstat, etc. via run_rtr_command).

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

host_id.description: Falcon host id to start a Real Time Response session on.
host_id.title: Host Id

tools.name: run_rtr_command
tools.description: Run a read-only RTR command (e.g. 'ls', 'ps', 'netstat', 'ifconfig') in an active RTR session and return its output.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

session_id.description: Active RTR session id from start_rtr_session.
session_id.title: Session Id

command_string.description: Full command string with arguments, e.g. 'ls C:\\Users'.
command_string.title: Command String

tools.name: list_vulnerabilities
tools.description: List Spotlight Vulnerabilities (CVE exposure) across the fleet, optionally filtered by an FQL expression (e.g. "cve.severity:'CRITICAL'").

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_falcon_estate
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across the connected Falcon tenant: stale hosts, open critical incidents, new detections, and disabled prevention policies.

connection_id.description: Optional saved Falcon tenant connection ID. Omit to use the first connected tenant.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: crowdstrike_connections
secrets.description: JSON list of connected CrowdStrike Falcon tenants (region + encrypted OAuth2 client credentials). Managed only through connect_crowdstrike and disconnect_crowdstrike.
